Now the task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl1-template_search-3 to the molecule below". The template ID is 1914390 (from template_search-3). The molecule below? Probably the same as the first SMILES? The question: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl1-template_search-3 to the molecule below?" The "molecule below" likely is the same as the first SMILES from previous answer? Actually the previous answer gave two SMILES: maybe they are product and something else? The template mapping shows product side: ...>>(...). The mapped_rxn shows product on left? Let's examine mapped_rxn: '(CCO[C:8]([CH2:7][C@@H:6]1[O:5][C@H:4](/[CH:3]=[C:2](/[CH3:1])[C:22](OC)=[O:23])[C@H:20]([CH3:21])[C@@H:11]([O:12][Si:13]([CH3:14])([CH3:15])[C:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19])[CH2:10]1)=[O:9])>>([CH3:1]/[C:2](=[CH:3]/[C@H:4]1[O:5][C@@H:6]([CH2:7][CH:8]=[O:9])[CH2:10][C@H:11]([O:12][Si:13]([CH3:14])([CH3:15])[C:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19])[C@H:20]1[CH3:21])[CH2:22][OH:23])'

So left side is reactant (precursor) and right side is product. The product SMILES likely matches the first SMILES? Let's check: product side: [CH3:1]/[C:2](=[CH:3]/[C@H:4]1[O:5][C@@H:6]([CH2:7][CH:8]=[O:9])[CH2:10][C@H:11]([O:12][Si:13]... )... This seems similar to the first SMILES? The first SMILES: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C. Yes that matches product.

Thus we need to apply template 1914390 to that product to get precursors (reactants). The apply_template call returned empty '()' meaning no precursors? Possibly need to use the other SMILES (the second) as product? Actually the second SMILES is "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". That might be the other reactant? The template likely is a disconnection between two fragments: maybe the product is formed from two reactants: the first SMILES (the complex) and the second (the phosphate ester). The apply_template should return list of precursor sets. It returned empty, maybe because the template expects a different representation (maybe need to include stereochemistry). Could try applying to the second SMILES? But the product is the complex; the template likely splits into two precursors: the complex with a leaving group and the phosphate. Actually the mapped_rxn shows left side: CCO[C:8]... which is a CCO attached to something (maybe the phosphate side). Right side is the product with a silyl group etc. Wait left side includes CCO attached to something: CCO[C:8]... So left side is maybe the phosphate ester? Actually left side includes CCO (ethyl) attached to O of something. The right side includes a silyl group.

Thus the precursors are: "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC" and something else? The left side also includes a fragment: CCO[C:8]([CH2:7][C@@H:6]1[O:5][C@H:4]... )=O . That seems like the product of the first SMILES with an ethoxy carbonyl? Hard.

Maybe the apply_template didn't work due to missing mapping. Could try check matching: use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching to see if template matches product.
